sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use a wide range of adverbs to indicate degrees of certainty.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: undoubtedly / undeniably / certainly / definitely / surely / presumably — high end of the certainty dial
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker marks the proposition as settled

positives: It was undoubtedly an unforgettable experience.
Television programmes are undeniably a powerful influence.

sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use an increasing range of adverbs ('completely', 'obviously', 'clearly', 'actually', 'luckily', 'honestly') to indicate an attitude or viewpoint.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: completely / obviously / clearly / actually / luckily / honestly — dial the speaker's stance up or down
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker takes explicit ownership of the stance

positives: I am completely sure of my answer.
It is obviously much more fun to go on vacation than stay at home.

sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use a wide range of stance adverbs (simply, truly, surely, apparently, naturally, surprisingly, inevitably) to indicate an attitude or viewpoint.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: simply / truly / surely / apparently / naturally / surprisingly / inevitably — finer-grained stance markers
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker marks nuanced distance from the proposition

positives: Obviously everybody has the right to be on a strike.
We can't truly blame ourselves for the outcome.

can_do_statement: Can use an increasing range of adverbs to indicate degrees of certainty.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: probably / possibly / certainly / definitely / surely / presumably — calibrate certainty at finer resolution
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker calibrates commitment to the proposition

positives: And it will probably be on TV next month!
If I were you I'd certainly choose not to go.
negatives: I went to the bank yesterday.
